name: DS Cluster D05: Futures Reference (curated + free-text)
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER D05: Futures Reference
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === CURATED FUTURES ===
es = common_reference_futures(ticker=ReferenceFutures.ES)()
es_close = es.c

# === FREE-TEXT FUTURES ===
gc = reference_futures(ticker="GC")()
gc_close = gc.c

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title="ES vs GC Reference",
    category="Futures",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="ES", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="GC", color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(es_close, gc_close))
